about_the_game:
Game Description

Are you ready?
Tonight is not an ordinary night. Tonight, you will confront your past—the night when fate puts you to your final test.

On the longest night of the year, a lonely man named Max is sent on a mysterious exploration mission to a place erased from maps — a forbidden zone called Ralkoz. He is unaware that he is heading there.

After losing his child and divorcing his wife, Max has never been able to recover. Unknowingly, he will cross into Ralkoz. On this journey, he will uncover both his child’s killer and the dark secrets of Ralkoz.

Game Features:

  • Single-player, cinematic story experience

  • First-person shooter gameplay

  • 6 different firearms

  • Enemies with unique abilities

  • Deep psychological and dramatic storytelling

  • The player’s goal: uncover the secrets of Ralkoz and change the fate of those who entered before

  • Approximately 4 hours of gameplay

  • A blend of exploration, horror, action, and drama in an atmospheric setting

  • A story reaching back to ancient times

  • Developed with the Unity game engine

Max thought he was just an ordinary man. To survive, he worked as a security guard, learned to handle weapons, and hunted. After losing his child, he lost everything. Eventually, he accepted an offer to investigate a government-hidden area. Drawn into Ralkoz without realizing it, he embarks on a journey to uncover both the secrets of his past and his child’s murderer.

content_descriptors.notes:
Mature Content Description

This game contains the following content:

Intense horror elements and atmospheric tension

Frequent gunfights and enemy-killing scenes

Depictions of blood and graphic violence

Themes of family tragedy, loss, and emotional breakdown

Psychological thriller aspects and a heavy emotional tone

short_description: Ralkoz is a single-player first-person action-horror game that tells the story of a man confronting the unknown after a life filled with loss. In abandoned forests, among mysterious structures, and across ancient times. Surviving is not enough — you must also uncover the truth.
